entities.name: Korvecdal
entities.description: Prophesied figure meant to unite the Kor, Vec and Dal tribes of Rath against the Evincar.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Weatherlight captain first proclaimed to be the Korvecdal.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: Rathi prophet who proclaimed Gerrard, then realized Eladamri was the Korvecdal.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Elf leader who was actually the Korvecdal.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Evincar the uprising tried to overthrow.

entities.name: Skyshroud Forest
entities.description: Home of the elves who aided the uprising.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Volrath's Stronghold, infiltrated by Gerrard's crew.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane of the Kor, Vec and Dal tribes.

events.summary: The Oracle en-Vec proclaimed Gerrard Capashen the promised one after the Weatherlight stranded on Rath.
events.quote: proclaimed that Gerrard Capashen was the promised one

events.summary: The Oracle, Eladamri and the Skyshroud elves rallied the Rathi tribes against Volrath while Gerrard's crew infiltrated the Stronghold.
events.quote: in an attempt to overthrow Volrath while Gerrard and the Weatherlight crew infiltrated the

events.summary: The uprising failed and the Weatherlight fled to Mercadia; the Oracle realized Eladamri was the Korvecdal.
events.quote: the Oracle en -Vec realized the prophecy foretold Eladamri as the Korvecdal
